user_questions.question: What counts as a duplicate review? Options: (a) same customer (Customer__c) + same storefront (Storefront__c) — one review per customer per storefront; (b) same customer + storefront + Order_Date__c — one per order. Evidence: 13 Customer+Storefront pairs already repeat (27 records), 0 repeat when Order_Date__c is added; AgentReviewActions never sets Order_Date__c. Recommendation: (a).
user_questions.simulated_answer: No preference; use your recommended default.

user_questions.question: Which reviews should the nightly AI summary draw on? Options: (a) reuse the existing AgentSummarizeReviewsActions action (all statuses, windowed by Order_Date__c); (b) only Published reviews via a new query; (c) all reviews regardless of date. Evidence: AgentSummarizeReviewsActions exists, returns stats + review list but writes nothing; default 30-day window returns 0 reviews today. Recommendation: (a) with a wider window.
user_questions.simulated_answer: Nightly summary via existing summarize action.

user_questions.question: Who should work the cases opened for 1-2 star reviews? Options: (a) default Case assignment rule 'Standard' (entries unreadable); (b) Merchant_Messaging_Queue (currently MessagingSession only); (c) a new dedicated queue. Evidence: only two queues exist, neither for Case. Recommendation: (c) a dedicated queue.

skill_friction: Rule 3 says after two wrong AskCoworker claims verify every fact kept; this run hit eight corrections (validation rules 'not queryable', VLOOKUP composite key, scheduled Apex as Automated Process user, undelete not restoring Set Null lookups, unique field deploy failing on existing data, non-AI stats string, broad FLS grants, nonexistent Origin value). The skill gives no guidance on whether to keep spending R/T calls once AskCoworker is this unreliable.

The I-call retry rule ('split I by responsibility; both halves count as one retry') produces two partial inventory tables; SKILL.md does not say how to merge them or whether the merged result must be resent as one I before R/T.
The 'more than 8 changes: split R into runtime and security' rule forced two R calls; askcoworker-calls.md has no distinct kind label for the halves (both recorded as 'r').

Backfill guidance ('existing data that breaks a new rule: enforce on create and change, list clean-up as data step') does not address a unique-key backfill where existing duplicates would make the backfill itself fail; I had to design a partial backfill (key only on the newest record per pair) myself.

No read-only way to confirm Einstein generative AI / Prompt Builder is enabled; org-verification.md covers licenses but not generative AI feature enablement, so the prompt template and dependent Apex rows became Conditional by judgement.
Aggregate GROUP BY on a Number (double) field fails in SOQL; org-verification.md suggests GROUP BY for value distribution without noting this restriction.
